bars.label: Pullback & stabilization presence ("setup" shorthand)
bars.interpretation: Macro/cross-sectional share of sampled symbols whose Opportunity score meets/exceeds the threshold. 'Setup' here means pullback-and-stabilization characteristics relative to each symbol’s own lookback history—not a prediction.

bars.label: Breakdown & fragility presence
bars.interpretation: Macro/cross-sectional share of sampled symbols whose Structural Risk score meets/exceeds the threshold. 'Fragility' here means weakness-and-instability characteristics relative to each symbol’s own lookback history—not a prediction.

bars.label: Net tilt (setup presence minus fragility presence)
bars.interpretation: Descriptive balance metric: pullback/setup presence minus fragility presence (percentage points). This summarizes cross-sectional conditions; it does not imply direction or timing.

glossary.scope_note: Breadth and posture summarize characteristics across many tickers (a macro / cross-sectional / inter-firm snapshot). They are not forecasts for the market or recommendations for any single asset.
glossary.opportunity_score: Per-asset score for pullback-and-stabilization characteristics relative to that asset’s own lookback history (e.g., ~1y). Trader shorthand: 'setup-like'. Higher = more setup-like.
glossary.structural_risk_score: Per-asset score for persistent weakness-and-instability characteristics relative to that asset’s own lookback history. Trader shorthand: 'fragility/breakdown-like'. Higher = more fragility-like.
glossary.thresholds: Thresholds convert continuous scores into 'presence' flags: Opportunity >= opp_thr counts as pullback/setup presence; Structural Risk >= risk_thr counts as fragility presence.
glossary.median: Cross-sectional median = the typical value across the tracked sample in this run.
glossary.iqr: IQR (interquartile range) measures dispersion across tickers: Q3 - Q1. Higher IQR means a wider spread of conditions across the universe (more disagreement/variety across names).
glossary.q25_q75: Q25 (25th percentile) and Q75 (75th percentile) bracket the middle 50% of tickers. They provide context for what 'typical range' looks like across names.
glossary.presence_counts: Presence counts report the exact numerator and denominator behind the breadth percentages (how many tickers met/exceeded the threshold out of the denom used).

posture.explanation: Breadth and posture summarize characteristics across many tickers (a macro / cross-sectional / inter-firm snapshot). They are not forecasts for the market or recommendations for any single asset. Macro breadth: ~60.0% show pullback/stabilization ('setup-like') characteristics; ~60.0% show weakness/instability ('fragility/breakdown-like') characteristics. Counts: setup-like 3/5, fragility-like 3/5. Balance (setup presence minus fragility presence): 0.0 pct-pts. Cross-sectional medians vs thresholds: Opportunity median 60.0 (threshold 60); Structural Risk median 70.0 (threshold 70). Dispersion across tickers: Opportunity Q25–Q75: 50.0–80.0 (IQR 30.0) | Risk Q25–Q75: 40.0–75.0 (IQR 35.0).
